name: Darcy Wu
life: “I still remember learning I was allowed to prefer the back seat.” People around the public end of the South Shore boardwalk know Darcy by a small Friday habit. Darcy checks the shade on the benches before deciding how long to stay.
voice: I turned down my slot because I don't want to drive. I asked the panel to take my bus-pass idea seriously too.
appearance: Darcy is easy to recognize by short black hair swept back and a flat bridge to the nose and a mobile brow. Usually dressed in a mustard canvas overshirt with a braided bracelet with a single wooden bead, Darcy rubs a thumb along the edge of the nearest pocket when listening.
personality: Darcy is kind in very practical ways and prickly about being thanked in public. Darcy loves being recognized by the people who notice what happens after the guests have left.
agenda: To get a bus pass considered beside driving tuition.
family: Bailey Valdez is Darcy’s half-sibling. Darcy knows which ones can be shared. Bailey keeps the photographs. They enjoy remembering people in public and also know what it feels like to have a private afternoon turned into an anecdote for strangers. Asked about *Reopening at six*, Bailey says, “I clean before opening. Every extra hour someone wins is an hour somebody else lifts out of a wet bin.”
connections: Bianca Moreau. A bus pass complicates a panel vote framed entirely around parents who need to drive.

reactions.situation: Someone asks whether the grant might buy a bus pass instead
reactions.response: Darcy prices a usable bus pass before dismissing it as a different kind of grant.

reactions.situation: A frightened child is waiting outside a shuttered shop
reactions.response: Darcy stays where the child can see the shop door and asks the neighboring counter to help find the adult expected there.
